response.original_title: Eric & Robyn and the Mythical Beasts
response.overview: ERIC & ROBYN AND THE MYTHICAL BEASTS, a wild and gentle tale of two artists in love, who turn the worst of happenings into magic and set off on a journey to win over the art world. After yet another rejection, Robyn hits on the idea to go for the big one. The life-changing Archibald Prize.
